name: OpenStock
use_label: Track prices and set your own alerts
one_liner: An open-source dashboard for tracking stock prices, company details and personalised alerts in one place.

text.why: Plenty of people pay for an expensive platform when all they need is prices and alerts. OpenStock isolates that part as open source: a price table, a sector heatmap and a watchlist on one screen.
text.take: The README draws its own limits up front, which reads as honest: it is not a brokerage, it is not financial advice, and the data may lag.
build: TypeScript under AGPL-3.0, offering real-time price tracking, personalised alerts and detailed company insights.

who.role: Individual investors watching a handful of tickers who mainly want an alert at a certain price.

start.text: Try the public demo at openstock-ods.vercel.app first, then follow the repository guide to self-host if you want to keep it.

caveat: Not a brokerage and not financial advice; market data may be delayed depending on the provider's rules and your configuration. Under AGPL-3.0, deploying a modified version as a web service means publishing your source.

license.scope_text: Release source if you redistribute or host it as a service.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: The OpenStock dashboard with a price list and chart on the left and a colour-coded sector heatmap on the right.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
